parameters.content:
## Export Los Angeles contractors with published business emails
For agencies and suppliers building a company contact list. The CSV records where the email was published. Mailbox deliverability is untested.

[Preview and try this search in Apify](https://apify.com/perceptive_city_af7/houzz-professionals-lead-scraper/examples/find-los-angeles-contractors-with-public-emails?utm_source=n8n_workflow&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=houzz_first_buyers&utm_content=la_contractors)

1. Open **Fetch up to five matching profiles**. Select an n8n Header Auth credential with name `Authorization` and value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`. Keep the token inside the credential.
2. Run manually. Each run returns up to five profiles and has a $0.01 spending limit. Fewer matches can qualify.
3. Open **Download shortlist as CSV → Binary → data** to save the file. Empty results yield a header-only file. If a request times out, check your Apify run history before retrying.
